facts.raw_span: A 30-year-old Asian man presented with a 6-month history of recurrent pain localized to the lateral side of his left knee
slight tenderness and swelling over the lateral joint line without other abnormalities
Plain radiographs were unremarkable
routine laboratory tests were within normal limits
MRI demonstrated a 1.5 cm intra-articular space-occupying lesion invading the tibial plateau
the lesion was homogeneous and isointense to muscle on T1-weighted images
the lesion appeared heterogeneous with internal specks on T2-weighted images
the lesion was unremarkable on fat-saturated T2 sequences
Gadolinium-enhanced MRI showed enhancement confined to the peripheral rim of the mass
no satellite lesions identified
